key: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
Song of the Welkin Moon Act I
0.comment: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
0.content: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves (also: Song of the Welkin Moon Act I, Welkin Moon Act I, Where the Moon Rises, Reunion Beneath the Moonlight, In the Shadows of Night): The first act of the Song of the Welkin Moon chapter and the Traveler's arrival in Nod-Krai. After a send-off in Natlan, the Traveler, Paimon and Ineffa sail north, feel kuuvahki for the first time and look for clues to the Traveler's crashed spaceship. They meet the Moonchanter Lauma of the Frostmoon Scions, learn the Fatui are hunting a "relic", and meet Columbina, whom the Scions call their goddess Kuutar. The Traveler and their sibling break into the sanctum holding the Moon Marrow, the Wild Hunt attacks, and in the end the Traveler agrees to carry the Marrow in their own body.

key: A Finale Emberforged World Quest series
An Omen of Annihilation and the Final Entreaty
1.content: A Finale Emberforged (also: A Finale Emberforged World Quest series, An Omen of Annihilation and the Final Entreaty, Little One's cleansing): A Finale Emberforged is the last chapter of the Little One storyline in Natlan, consisting of a single quest, An Omen of Annihilation and the Final Entreaty. The Traveler and Little One offer both Golden Entreaties in the Heart of the Sacred Mountain and face the Sage of the Stolen Flame, who proves to be Kukulkan. He wants a dragon to activate the Huitzilopochtli array, which would turn Natlan into pure phlogiston. Little One refuses, breaks free, and with the Traveler defeats the Source Dragon Mech; its Flamelord's Blessing is cleansed.

key: A Gifted Rose World Quest series
2.content: A Gifted Rose (also: A Gifted Rose World Quest series, Affan's Golden Rose quests): A Gifted Rose is a five-part world quest series in the Great Red Sand, Sumeru, added in version 3.1. On the edge of Aaru Village, a lonely old man named Affan is trying to grow three stone-like seeds left to him by a dead neighbour, an exile the villagers call the "old ghost". With the Amurta researcher Sabbah, the Traveler and Paimon get the seeds to sprout and bloom as Golden Roses.

key: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains
3.comment: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains
3.content: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains (also: Everfrozen Earth snow giant quest): A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains is a Snezhnaya World Quest added in version 7.0. In a blizzard in the Everfrozen Earth, the Traveler and Paimon find a huge snow giant bound to the ground by chains of snow and ice. The chains can be broken only with help from a girl's shadow, who leads them through four small scenes from a house and its past. When all four are broken, the storm clears and the giant stands and walks away.

4.content:
A Land Entombed (also: Ancient Investigation Journal quest): A Dragonspine world quest from Version 1.2. The Traveler finds an Ancient Investigation Journal and takes it to the researcher Stevens, who explains it belongs to an old expedition sent up the mountain by Mondstadt's aristocrats. The Traveler recovers the other two parts.

Plot: The Traveler and Paimon pick up a journal in the mountains and show it to Stevens at the camp. He asks them to find the two other parts, marks the sites, and after reading all three tells them an aristocrat-led expedition seems to have been lost, with Eberhart perhaps the sole possible survivor.

Characters: The Traveler, Paimon and Stevens.

key: A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon
5.comment: A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon
5.content: A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon (also: Lantern Rite 2026, Luna IV Lantern Rite event, The Realm of Clouds, The Realm of Rocks, The Realm of People, White Horse's Leisurely Journey, Odes of Lang: Zibai): A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon is the Lantern Rite story of Version 6.3 (Luna IV), told in three acts and an epilogue: The Realm of Clouds, The Realm of Rocks, The Realm of People and White Horse's Leisurely Journey. In Liyue Harbor the Traveler touches a broken jade token at an antiques exhibition, meets a fragment of the legendary White Horse Adeptus, Zibai, and learns from Zhongli that Zibai died long ago and that her soul survives in three Deadly Selves. Over several days the Traveler and Paimon help gather the Selves, and on Lantern Rite night Zibai is revived, confused but alive.

key: A Long Day in the Mountains
6.comment: A Long Day in the Mountains
6.content:
A Long Day in the Mountains (also: Magic Mountain, Paradise, Hell, Judgment, Temple of Space chapter, Zeitlind's quest): A Version 6.5 world quest chapter set around Dornman Port and the Old Sanatorium Site on Windrest Peak, then inside the Temple of Space. A young woman named Zeitlind is searching for her older sister Hilda, who vanished from the sanatorium. A towering angelic Watcher, Nihilita, sends the Traveler to free the temple from his counterpart Melanta.

Plot: A man, Mann, warns people not to go up the mountain after seeing a ghost at the old sanatorium: a woman beside a grave with her own face. The Traveler meets Zeitlind, who is looking for her sister, and the red-sky Watcher Nihilita traps her and sends the Traveler to the Temple of Space. There the group helps the inhabitants, finds Hilda's belongings, and finally confronts Melanta.

Revelations: The Temple of Space is run by Watchers created by the God of Space, Asmoday, and one of them, Melanta, rules by fear.

Characters: The Traveler and Paimon; Zeitlind; Raumhilda (Hilda); Nihilita; Melanta; Dex; Istoria.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon Act III
7.content: A Nation That Doesn't Exist (also: Song of the Welkin Moon Act III, Welkin Moon Act III, Hidden in the Shadows, Special Operation, Everlasting As the Moon): The third act of the Song of the Welkin Moon chapter. With Rerir's body restored, the master of the Wild Hunt drains kuuvahki from Nod-Krai and attacks Columbina, and the Traveler and their allies are forced to hide and prepare. Nefer's ceremony shows Rerir's life as a Khaenri'ahn, and Arlecchino, a fellow Fatui Harbinger, opens a path to the last Moon Marrow, the Iridescent one.

8.content:
A New Star Approaches (also: Chapter I Act III, Liyue Archon Quest Act III): Chapter I Act III of the Archon Quest, set in Liyue. The Traveler is invited to the Jade Chamber, helps the adepti and the Qixing stop the sealed god Osial, and discovers that Zhongli is the Geo Archon, Morax, who staged his own "death" and hands his Gnosis to the Fatui.

Plot: The Traveler and Paimon reach the Jade Chamber, join the Qixing and adepti against the ancient god Osial, and then find Zhongli at Northland Bank, where he reveals he is Rex Lapis and gives his Gnosis to Signora.

Revelations: Zhongli is the Geo Archon, Rex Lapis (Morax), and staged his own death.

Characters: Traveler and Paimon; Zhongli; Ningguang; Ganyu; Keqing; Childe (Tartaglia); Signora.

key: A Nocturne of the Far North
Song of the Welkin Moon Act V
9.comment: A Nocturne of the Far North
9.content:
A Nocturne of the Far North (also: Song of the Welkin Moon Act V, Welkin Moon Act V, Luna III Archon Quest): Act V of the Song of the Welkin Moon Archon Quest, set in Nod-Krai. As the festival of Moon-Prayer Night approaches, the Traveler and friends plan a farewell for Columbina, who intends to return to the moon, while phantoms of the past appear across the region. Then Columbina begins to vanish from the world, and the search for her true name begins.

Plot: The Traveler and Paimon turn to Moon-Prayer Night after finishing their guild work. They learn Columbina plans to return to the moon at the festival, while mysterious phantoms appear across Nod-Krai. In the second quest, Columbina vanishes, Alice explains that she is fading out of existence, and the party seeks a way to rescue her.

Revelations: Columbina is fading out of existence because the world is rejecting her.

Characters: Traveler and Paimon; Columbina; Lauma; Varka; Alice; Nicole.

10.content: A Parade of Providence (also: Akademiya Extravaganza event, Interdarshan Championship, Diadem of Knowledge event): A Parade of Providence was a limited-time event in Version 3.6 (27 April to 15 May 2023). The Sumeru Akademiya held its Akademiya Extravaganza and a once-in-four-years Interdarshan Championship, and the Traveler and Paimon were hired as roving commentators. Behind the games lay the story of Sachin, an absent sponsor who left part of his mind in a diadem, and of Kaveh, who won the crown and refused the fortune.

key: A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks
11.comment: A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks
11.content: A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks (also: Children of Echoes Tribal Chronicle, Tepetli Dissonance, Hoarse Echoes, Melodious Chant): The Children of Echoes' chapter of the Tribal Chronicles, which also serves as Xilonen's story. A gem artisan named Cheven, rescued by the Traveler, leads them to Tlazolli, a retired Ancient Name forger who says she is nursing her sick daughter Nechca. In Act III it emerges that Nechca died years ago and the girl in Tlazolli's house is an orphan, Nepecha, whom Tlazolli has been remaking into her daughter with memory-stealing Blazegem Inscriptions. Xilonen and the Traveler stop the ritual and Nepecha is taken in by Xilonen.

12.content: A Rekviem for the Underworld (also: Chapter VII Act IV, Rekviem for the Underworld, Black Feathers Scattered at Parting): A Rekviem for the Underworld is Act IV of Chapter VII, released in Version 7.1 as the last Archon Quest content at the canon cutoff. The Fatui plan their showdown with Ronova, the Ruler of Death: Arlecchino helps test a new Delusion, the Harbingers vote to open a forbidden notebook left by the Sinner Hroptatyr, and the Traveler joins Pierro and Dainsleif in holding Ronova in place while the Tsaritsa outmaneuvers the Sinner Rhinedottir. Ronova loses her authority, then sabotages a Celestial Nail as she flees.

key: A Space and Time for You
A Space and Time Without You
13.comment: A Space and Time for You
13.content: A Space and Time for You (also: Chapter V Act VI, The Key That Unlocks Fate, A Space and Time Without You): A Space and Time for You is Act VI of the Natlan chapter and a Traveler chapter, the Traveler and Paimon's personal storyline. In Natlan they find their lost sibling's spaceship key, meet a woman called Direidyth who seems to be looking for a "Savior", fight the Abyss Order with Dainsleif, and discover the sibling has used the Loom of Fate to weave new Khaenri'ah Ley Lines.

key: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
Song of the Welkin Moon Act VII
14.comment: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
14.content:
A Traveler on a Winter's Night (also: Song of the Welkin Moon Act VII, Welkin Moon Act VII, Luna IV Archon Quest): Act VII of the Song of the Welkin Moon Archon Quest, set in Nod-Krai. Dottore, armed with an artificial Moon Marrow, defeats the party's attempt to stop him and captures the Traveler. While the region is evacuated and strange energy fields appear, Columbina, trapped in the moon's reflection, travels back through memories to leave messages and aid for her friends.

Plot: After the Dottore incident, the Fatui send word that Arlecchino and Sandrone are heading for Dottore's lab. The party follows, fights Dottore, and the Traveler is captured. The rest of the group organises an evacuation and tries to find the Traveler, while Columbina uses the moon's reflection to influence the past.

Revelations: Dottore has built an artificial Moon Marrow, carries a Trilune holding the Moon Marrows, has replaced the Frost Moon with an artificial moon, and captured the Traveler.

Characters: Traveler and Paimon; Dottore; Columbina; Arlecchino; Sandrone; the Curatorium group.

key: Upon the Plain, a Purple Shadow
Through the Mist, a Name Unveiled
Ere the End, a Glance Back
15.content:
Acer Palmatum Chapter (also: Acer Palmatum, Kazuha's Story Quest, A Strange and Friendless Road, Upon the Plain, a Purple Shadow, Through the Mist, a Name Unveiled, Ere the End, a Glance Back): The Acer Palmatum Chapter is Kaedehara Kazuha's Story Quest, released in Version 2.8, and has one act, A Strange and Friendless Road. After Kazuha blocked the Raiden Shogun's attack in Omnipresence Over Mortals he is famous in Inazuma, and a stranger starts attacking people who fight like him. The Traveler helps him trace the stranger, a samurai possessed by a cursed sword, and settle the matter without a killing.

Plot: On Byakko Plain a samurai attacks the Traveler and Paimon, then realises they are not Kazuha and leaves. They go to warn Kazuha at the Tenryou Commission Headquarters, where Kujou Kamaji has offered to restore Kazuha's clan's name. Kazuha and the Traveler trace the attacker to Amenoma Yuuya, possessed by a sword full of Tatarigami, and Kazuha beats the sword and persuades it to be reborn as a reference for the Isshin Art.

16.content: Agnihotra Sutra (also: Agnihotra Sutra World Quest series, Starry Night Chapter, Risen Moon Chapter, The Final Chapter (Agnihotra Sutra), Arahaoma ritual quests): Agnihotra Sutra is a Sumeru world quest series from version 3.0, following The World of Aranara. The Traveler and Paimon help the Aranara Aranakin, Aragaru and Aranaga collect three plants, the Zohrah Mushroom, the Barsam Flower and the Yajna Grass, to make the potion Arahaoma. It is offered to the gate-guardian Jamikayomars so they can enter Mawtiyima and clear the Marana, a corruption that is devouring her.

key: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
17.comment: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
17.content:
Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises (also: Chapter III Act V, Sumeru Archon Quest Act V): Chapter III Act V of the Archon Quest. The Traveler, Paimon and a coalition of Sumeru's scholars, mercenaries and Eremites carry out a plan to free Nahida, then enter the Akasha with her to defeat Scaramouche, who is being made into a false god. Nahida cleanses Irminsul of the forbidden knowledge by erasing Rukkhadevata from it, and Dottore bargains with her for the Electro Gnosis.

Plot: Alhaitham, Cyno, Dehya and Rahman plan to rescue Nahida from the Akademiya's Akasha. After Cyno has Rahman's men arrested to get them into Sumeru City and the Traveler learns Dottore's movements, the plan is carried out on Jnagarbha Day. Alhaitham feigns insanity, the Traveler wakes Nahida inside the Akasha and Nahida takes the system back. Together she and the Traveler defeat Scaramouche in the Akasha, restore Irminsul by removing Rukkhadevata, and Nahida trades the Electro Gnosis to Dottore. A feast follows.

Revelations: Rukkhadevata made Nahida as her successor and is erased from Irminsul and from everyone's memory to cure the forbidden knowledge. Scaramouche was being turned into a false god. Dottore wants the Electro Gnosis and hints at the "false sky".

Characters: The Traveler, Paimon, Nahida, Alhaitham, Cyno, Dehya, Scaramouche and Dottore are the principals.

18.content:
Akitsu Kimodameshi (also: Test of Courage event, Haunted Tales, The Currents of Life, Akitsu Yuugei): Akitsu Kimodameshi was a limited-time Flagship event in Version 3.3 (15 December 2022 to 2 January 2023) tied to the Mikawa Flower Festival. Kamisato Ayato and the Yashiro Commission hold a three-round "Test of Courage" in Chinju Forest, with prizes from the Grand Narukami Shrine. The Traveler and Paimon join, run into what seem to be ghosts, and find that the scares come from small youkai planning a festival and from a weary hagoita spirit named Hanyuuda Chizuru. Gameplay-wise it added the brick-breaking game Akitsu Yuugei.

Plot: Part I, "Test of Courage": the Traveler and Paimon hear of the contest, meet Ayato at the Yashiro Commission, and then meet Itto, who plans to scare people because his gang finds the event boring. A shrine maiden (Hitomi) runs the contest and says "Traveler and Paimon" count as one entrant, so they pick a partner from Ayaka, Gorou or Kazuha. Round one's object is Dango Milk. Afterwards Itto leaps out at three figures who are not his gang; both groups flee. Back in the forest a veiled woman warns the pair to leave, and a sweet flower scent knocks them out. Heizou wakes them.

19.content:
Alatus Chapter (also: Butterfly's Dream, Xiao's Story Quest, Alatus Chapter Act I): Alatus Chapter is Xiao's Story Quest, with one act, Butterfly's Dream. Near Wangshu Inn the Traveler and Paimon meet a masked man calling himself the adeptus Starsnatcher, who sells wishes for Mora. His sigil is attracting malevolent hilichurls, and Xiao, the last of the Yakshas, is the one quietly cleansing them.

Plot: Outside Wangshu Inn the Traveler fights hilichurls radiating evil. A masked man, Starsnatcher, claims to be an adeptus and to grant wishes for faith, meaning Mora. A book at Wanwen Bookhouse about the Yakshas makes the Traveler and Paimon suspect he is a fraud. Following the evil aura, they find Xiao, who explains the trouble comes from his karma and lets them help cleanse a cavern. They then use an adeptal ritual to confront Starsnatcher, who turns out to be an ordinary man.

Characters: Xiao (the Vigilant Yaksha), Paimon and the Traveler, plus Starsnatcher (Wang Ping'an), Pervases, and Verr Goldet at Wangshu Inn.

key: Knights of Favonius potion shop event
20.content: Alchemical Ascension (also: Alchemy and Business Operations, Knights of Favonius potion shop event): Alchemical Ascension was a limited-time Flagship Event in Version 4.5 (14 March to 1 April 2024). Lisa, working for the Knights of Favonius, asked the Traveler and Paimon to help run a potion shop by Cider Lake, part of a plan to promote the achievements of alchemy to the public and gather their feedback. The story chapter is called Alchemy and Business Operations.

21.content:
Alcyon Chapter (also: Linnea's Story Quest, Up! Toward Homecoming Wings, Spirit Envoy Championship): Linnea's Story Quest, set in Nod-Krai. The Traveler helps Linnea and her Jack Frost partner Lumi compete in the Spirit Envoy Championship, a tournament pairing people with animal companions. A rival, Celaeno, turns out to be Linnea's fae sister, and Linnea learns what kind of fae she is.

Plot: Katheryne mentions the Frostmoon Scions' Spirit Envoy Championship. The Traveler finds Linnea, who enters with Lumi. Over several rounds a mysterious fae, Celaeno, appears, Linnea faints and dreams, and she learns Celaeno is her sister. Celaeno explains their kind and Linnea's fate. In the semifinal Lumi grows huge and Linnea calms her. The Traveler wins the final.

Revelations: Linnea is an Augury Bird, a rare fae who can foresee their own futures; she has an older sister, Celaeno.

Characters: Linnea, the Traveler, Paimon, Lumi, Aguara and Celaeno.

22.content: All Fires Fuel the Flame (also: Chapter V Interlude, For the Same Land): All Fires Fuel the Flame is the Interlude Act of the Natlan chapter, a quiet aftermath story set after the Abyssal invasion. The Traveler and Paimon help Iansan treat three Flower-Feather Clan warriors who were broken by the fighting, and Capitano appears with medicine and a few grim admissions about Ronova.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon Act IV
23.content:
An Elegy for Faded Moonlight (also: Song of the Welkin Moon Act IV): Act IV of Song of the Welkin Moon. Dainsleif and Albedo, with Durin, join the Nod-Krai allies. In a ritual the group views Rerir's past as a Khaenri'ahn Sinner. Rerir turns on Nefer, and in the final fight Columbina, helped by an alchemical array and Dainsleif, throws him through a moon gate out of Teyvat.

Plot: At the allies' secret base the Traveler reunites with Flins, who met Albedo and a young man introduced as Mini Durin. Varka brings Dainsleif. The group enters Rerir's past at the Curatorium, then is pulled into a desert domain where Rerir attacks Nefer. Afterwards the group prepares and fights him, and Columbina flicks him into a moon gate held by Dainsleif.

Revelations: Rerir's tragedy: he lost his fiancee Tholindis and accepted power from a voice. Rerir himself is cast out of Teyvat.

Characters: The Traveler, Paimon, Columbina, Dainsleif, Nefer, Flins and Rerir are the main figures.

key: An Unwavering Culinary Dream World Quest series
24.content: An Unwavering Culinary Dream (also: An Unwavering Culinary Dream World Quest series, Aranara cooking training, A Delicacy for Nara, Arapacati's four brothers): An Unwavering Culinary Dream is a Sumeru world quest series added in version 3.0 and unlocked after The World of Aranara. In Vanarana the Aranara Arapacati asks the Traveler to find her four "brothers", Arachatora, Arasaka, Arapas and Araphala, who left long ago for "cooking training" and do not know Festival Utsava is near. Each is cooking a Supreme Delicacy, and each needs a small favour to finish it. Arapacati finally asks the Traveler to cook human food at the festival.

key: A Brush of Seafoam and Crimson
A Gradient of Dreams and Ochre
Blue Longing of Heart and Moon
25.content: Ancient Colors (also: Seymour's Story: Prologue, A Brush of Seafoam and Crimson, A Gradient of Dreams and Ochre, Blue Longing of Heart and Moon): Ancient Colors is a three-act Fontaine World Quest series added in version 4.0, listed in the Fontaine Reputation menu as "Seymour's Story: Prologue". The Traveler meets Mamere, a Melusine who paints, and her talking machine friend Seymour, helps repair him, and then discovers that a man named Jakob is trying to revive the buried heart of Mamere's "Father" beneath Merusea Village.

key: This Life, Just Like a Light Trickle of Song
26.content:
Animula Choragi Chapter (also: Animula Choragi, Furina's Story Quest, The Little Oceanid, To Yesterday, Whither Should the Water Flow?, This Life, Just Like a Light Trickle of Song): Furina's Story Quest, set in Fontaine after the Archon Quest fallout of the Masquerade of the Guilty. The Traveler and Paimon take a Guild commission from a small amateur troupe whose director died and whose lead actress is ill. They coax Furina, who has sworn off acting, into helping. The troupe finishes the director's last play, The Little Oceanid, and stages it at the Opera Epiclese.

Plot: Lauwick, an amateur troupe member, asks the Guild for help: their director is dead and their lead actress Dulphy is ill. The Traveler suggests Furina, who refuses at first and then relents. The group finds the troupe's writer and lead actor, learns the director's story, and stages her unfinished play at the Opera Epiclese, with Furina directing, stepping in on stage, and receiving a Vision.

Revelations: Furina receives a Vision at the end of the play.

Characters: Furina, the Traveler, Paimon and the troupe led by Lauwick.

key: If She No Longer Dreams of You
27.content: Ann of the Narzissenkreuz (also: Ann's Story: Prologue, The Narzissenkreuz Adventure, Kingdom Through the Looking-Glass, If She No Longer Dreams of You): Ann of the Narzissenkreuz is a three-act World Quest series in Fontaine, added in version 4.0 and shown in the Fontaine Reputation menu as "Ann's Story: Prologue". A tiny Oceanid called Ann, who says she belongs to the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team, asks the Traveler to be her "knight" in a fairy-tale rescue of a "Princess Lyris" from the "fell dragon Narcissus". Along the way the setting stops making sense, and the series ends by showing that the underwater kingdom of Annapausis is a dream-world kept by someone else.

key: The Spindrift Shall Never Return to the Sea
28.content: Aphros Delos Chapter (also: Aphros Delos, Eula's Story Quest, The Spindrift Shall Never Return to the Sea, Chapter of Wave Foam): Aphros Delos Chapter is Eula's Story Quest (added in Version 1.5), a single act titled "The Spindrift Shall Never Return to the Sea". Jean asks the Traveler to approach Schubert, a proud member of the disgraced Lawrence Clan suspected of dealing with the Fatui. Because he despises anyone without noble manners, the Traveler is sent to Eula, a Knights of Favonius officer who was born a Lawrence, to learn etiquette.

29.content: Apocalypse Lost (also: Memories of Gurabad, Apocalypse Lost World Quest series, Chessboard of Safhe Shatranj quest): Apocalypse Lost is a world quest series in the Desert of Hadramaveth, Sumeru, released in version 3.4. It has a single quest, Memories of Gurabad. Once the Traveler has placed all five chess pieces on the chessboard at Safhe Shatranj, the jinni Liloupar leads them through a vision of ancient Gurabad. She tells her own story of ruining her husband's line, and then goes into the city, leaving the Traveler her bottle.

30.content:
Aranyaka (also: Aranyaka world quest series, Woodland Encounter, Festival Utsava): A four-part Sumeru world quest series from Version 3.0. The Traveler and Paimon meet a Forest Watcher named Rana, whose village's children keep vanishing and returning with no memory. After Rana is sickened by the Withering, the pair enter the dream world of the Aranara, forest spirits, and help them hold a festival and destroy an avatar of the Withering so that a Bija, a life-giving seed, can be made.

Plot: Leaving Gandharva Ville, the Traveler and Paimon rescue a Forest Watcher named Rana from fungi and go with her to Vimara Village. The village's children have been vanishing and returning with no memory. After Rana is struck down by the Withering, an Aranara named Arana says she needs a Bija and sends the Traveler to Vanarana, the Aranara's dream-world village. There they win the Aranara's trust, help hold Festival Utsava, and finally destroy Marana's Avatar in Old Vanarana so a new Ashvattha tree can bear a Bija. The Bija wakes Rana.

Characters: The Traveler, Paimon, Rana, and the Aranara Arana, Arama and Araja.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon Act IX
31.content:
As All Falls to Emptiness (also: Song of the Welkin Moon Act IX): Song of the Welkin Moon Act IX, set in Sumeru. A letter about Collei's warning dream sends the Traveler and Paimon from Nod-Krai back to Sumeru City, where Nahida has taken on Irminsul's overload and collapsed. With a barrier sealing Sumeru off, the Traveler helps scholars, Eremites and Nod-Krai visitors regroup, fend off Jinn and Fatui, find the sleeping Liloupar, and win the Seven Pillars' agreement to open Aaru.

Plot: Collei's letter and a dream warn the Traveler of trouble in Sumeru. Irminsul has stopped processing information, Nahida has taken over its work and collapses, and everyone is evacuated to Caravan Ribat. The allies plan to restart the Akasha System, the Traveler takes Nahida to Apep, and the Fatui and Jinn attack. After Liloupar is found and the Jinn pacified, the Seven Pillars agree to open Aaru.

Revelations: Irminsul is blocked and overloaded, and Nahida is strained by it. The god remains inside Collei were Nabu Malikata's. The Heavenly Principles usurped Irminsul from ancient dragonkind. A barrier has sealed Sumeru.

Characters: The Traveler, Paimon, Nahida, Cyno, Alhaitham, Collei, Tighnari, Liloupar, Jeht, Nicole and Nefer are the principals.

key: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason
Like the Faint Moonlight of Yesteryear
The Truth, Lost With the Rain
When All Return to the Waters
32.comment: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason
32.content: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason (also: Chapter IV Act II, Like the Faint Moonlight of Yesteryear, The Truth, Lost With the Rain, When All Return to the Waters): The second act of Fontaine's Archon Quest. The Traveler and Paimon join Navia of Spina di Rosula in tracing the serial disappearances of young women, which prove to be people dissolved into Primordial Seawater and tied to the death of Navia's father Callas. The case ends in a trial that exposes the culprit, Marcel, after which the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale returns a "Guilty" verdict against the Fatui Harbinger Tartaglia (Childe).

33.content:
Astrolabos Chapter (also: Mona's Story Quest, Beyond This World's Stars, Astrology and the 50-Year Pact): Mona's Story Quest. A broke astrologer who knows the Traveler is not from Teyvat offers to read their fate if they help her reclaim a box her master left in Mondstadt. They travel from Liyue to Mondstadt, where the box's guardian turns out to be Klee, and Mona ends up renting a sealed laboratory.

Plot: Outside Liyue Harbor Mona meets the Traveler and Paimon and says that, as a disciple, the Traveler can help her win a contest of astrology. She takes them through Liyue and over the Stone Gate to Mondstadt. There she names Klee as the guardian of her master's box, but the box holds only Klee's treasures; the real contents were a diary. Mona rents a sealed lab from Goth.

Revelations: The box guardian is Klee, and the box's original content was Mona's master's diary.

Characters: Mona, the Traveler, Paimon and Klee.

34.content:
Autumn Winds, Scarlet Leaves (also: Chapter II Prologue, Inazuma Prologue, The Crux Clash, A Path Through the Storm, Follow the Wind): Autumn Winds, Scarlet Leaves is the prologue act of Archon Quest Chapter II, released in Version 1.6, and it is set in Liyue, at Liyue Harbor and Guyun Stone Forest. The Traveler wants to reach Inazuma, which is sealed off by storms and a strict isolation policy, and is sent to the Crux Fleet captain Beidou, who runs a tournament for fighters without Visions. The Traveler wins it, and in the process meets Kazuha, a wandering crew member who carries the Vision of a dead friend.

Plot: Looking over Liyue Harbor after the events of We Will Be Reunited, the Traveler decides to keep going toward the Unknown God. Atsuko, the one Inazuman they know, warns that the storm around Inazuma and the nation's isolation make the trip dangerous and points them to Beidou. Beidou offers passage on the Alcor if the Traveler wins her tournament, the Crux Clash. The Traveler wins after Kazuha retrieves a stolen Vision.

key: Bantan Sango Case Files: The Warrior Dog
The Truth (Just About) Comes to Light
35.comment: Bantan Sango Case Files: The Warrior Dog
35.content:
Bantan Sango Case Files: The Warrior Dog (also: The Warrior Dog, Mystery of the Black Shadow, Stealthy Trail, The Truth (Just About) Comes to Light, Black Shadow case, Ubiquity Net event): Bantan Sango Case Files: The Warrior Dog was a limited-time event in Version 2.3 (7 to 20 December 2021). The Bantan Sango Detective Agency in Inazuma City has received a flood of reports about missing pets and other small animals and asks the Traveler to help its field investigator Ryuuji. The culprits turn out to be both Treasure Hoarders and a swift masked dog, the "Black Shadow".

Plot: Katheryne tells the Traveler that the agency wants an experienced adventurer to accompany Ryuuji on investigations into the "large scale disappearance of many small animals". Detective Sango stays at the agency and pays a generous bounty. Ryuuji says he was knocked out by a "dark shadow" while trying to free animals at a camp, and the Traveler finds that the shadow is a dog guarding the cages.

key: Battlefield of Dice, Cats, and Cards
36.comment: Battlefield of Dice, Cats, and Cards
36.content: Battlefield of Dice, Cats, and Cards (also: Come Try Genius Invokation TCG!, Genius Invokation TCG introduction quest): Battlefield of Dice, Cats, and Cards is a Mondstadt world quest series, added in Version 3.3, that introduces the player to the card game Genius Invokation TCG. It has a single quest, Come Try Genius Invokation TCG!, set mainly at The Cat's Tail tavern. The Traveler, Paimon and the alchemist Sucrose learn the rules from Diona, win duels against three opponents and become officially recognised players.

37.content: Bedtime Story (also: Chapter IV Act VI, Vimara Village missing-person case): Bedtime Story is the sixth and final act of Chapter IV, the Traveler's Archon Quest chapter (version 4.7). A commission from Katheryne in Sumeru City asks for help finding a missing man from Vimara Village whom no one can name. Investigating, the Traveler and Paimon meet Dainsleif, who tells them about the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, and finally meet Caribert, Chlothar Alberich's son, whose residual consciousness is tied to the Loom of Fate.

key: Beneath the Lunar Sea world quest
38.content:
Beneath the Lunar Sea (also: Beneath the Lunar Sea world quest, Curtain-Form Blackbody Containment Lab quest): A Frost Moon world quest from Version 6.7 (Luna VIII). A frightened kuuhenki and a crowd of moonglow jellyfish lead the Traveler and Paimon to a sealed, dragon-built facility beneath the Moontide Sea, the Curtain-Form Blackbody Containment Lab. Restoring its power opens the way to a hidden chamber with a great blue tree.

Plot: Paimon spots a scared kuuhenki, and after the Traveler beats the monster harassing it, the creature guides them toward a cave. Jellyfish crowd into the cave too. Inside is a locked facility; the Traveler finds how to open it, gets the power back on and enters.

Characters: The Traveler and Paimon. The only other presences are a frightened kuuhenki, moonglow jellyfish and the facility's guardian constructs.

key: Between Pledge and Forgettance World Quest series
39.content: Between Pledge and Forgettance (also: Between Pledge and Forgettance World Quest series, Little One's volcano pilgrimage quests, Rite of the Bold, Revelations from the Past): Between Pledge and Forgettance is a Natlan world quest series made of Lost in the Woods, Rite of the Bold and Revelations from the Past. The Traveler and Paimon rescue a young marked saurian (called Little One by default), learn that its Flamelord's Blessing is dangerous, win Chief Pacal's talisman, and then clear the ancient ruins of the Sage of the Stolen Flame to earn the first of two Golden Entreaties. It is the first half of the pilgrimage to cleanse the saurian at the Great Volcano of Tollan.

40.content:
Beyond Silver and Fine Gold (also: Nicole's treasure hunt, Nicole's Witch's Lodge series): A Version 6.6 world quest series about Nicole. After the Traveler and Paimon unlock her Witch's Lodge in the Witch's Garden, Nicole turns its rooms into a treasure hunt: each of four rooms hides three golden feathers and a chest, and each room opens a week after the last. Between the puzzles she tells stories about her angelic past, the Hexenzirkel and her friends.

Plot: Nicole invites the Traveler and Paimon to her lodge. She has built a room full of tricks and hidden three feathers in it; finding them reveals a treasure chest. A new room opens each week: a tea party where everyone shrinks, a studio of magic paintings, a shrine of angel statues and a tall study full of books that make stairways when Nicole speaks.

Characters: Nicole is the host. The Traveler and Paimon are the guests and the only voices besides hers. Alice, Anya, Barbeloth, Rhinedottir and Ivanovna of the Hexenzirkel, and an old Seelie friend, are mentioned but do not appear.

41.content: Beyond the Smoke and Mirrors (also: Chapter V Act III, Natlan Archon Quest Act III): Beyond the Smoke and Mirrors is the third act of Chapter V, the Natlan Archon Quest (version 5.1). Xilonen is asked to forge an Ancient Name for the Traveler, an outsider, and the search for help leads to the shaman Citlali and her missing tribesman Ororon, who turns out to be working with the Fatui Harbinger Capitano. The act ends as the Abyss attacks the whole nation and the Traveler learns of a dangerous backup plan.

key: Black Stone Under a White Stone
42.comment: Black Stone Under a White Stone
42.content: Black Stone Under a White Stone (also: Chapter V Act II, Natlan Archon Quest Act II): Black Stone Under a White Stone is the second act of Chapter V, the Natlan Archon Quest (version 5.0). When Kachina fails to return from the Pilgrimage of the Sacred Flame and Mavuika cannot find her or her Ancient Name, the Traveler, Mualani and Chasca (later joined by Iansan) go into the Abyss-corrupted Night Kingdom to bring her back, while the Fatui Harbinger Capitano publicly challenges the Pyro Archon.

43.content: Blessings of the Frost Moon (also: Blessings of the Frost Moon (Part 2), Frostmoon Enclave library quest): Blessings of the Frost Moon is a World Quest in the Frostmoon Enclave on Hiisi Island, Nod-Krai (Version 6.0). Lauma, the Frostmoon Scions' Moonchanter, who understands all animal speech, needs help to pull a buried statue called the Lunar Semblance out of a Moon Mirror, a task her animal friends cannot manage. The Traveler works paired mechanisms with her while she directs them through a watching ibis. The statue ends up in the Scions' library. A second part, unlocked later, shows the finished Grand Library and Lauma's reasons for opening it to animals as well as humans.

44.content:
Bough Keeper: Dainsleif (also: Dainsleif Travel Log, Chapter I Act IV Prelude): Bough Keeper: Dainsleif is a Mondstadt world quest from Version 1.3 that works as the prelude to Chapter I, Act IV of the Archon Quests. Katheryne tells the Traveler about a tall blond stranger with an eyepatch. The Traveler and Paimon find him at the Angel's Share, where he introduces himself as Dainsleif and agrees to be commissioned for 500 Mora and three questions. He takes only work against the Abyss Order, and together they search the Temple of the Falcon, Wolvendom and Stormterror's Lair for an Abyss Herald without finding one. The quest ends at a trampled dandelion that the Traveler senses a link to their sibling through.

Plot: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild says a tall, unusually dressed stranger with an eyepatch has arrived in Mondstadt and refused the Guild's invitation. Lawrence at the gate lost track of him, Wagner says he asked for odd forging materials, and Charles says he drinks at the Angel's Share every night. The Traveler waits on the tavern's upper floor, then meets him.

key: In the Hall of the Sea King
45.content: Canticles of Harmony (also: Petrichorror Dream, In the Hall of the Sea King, Prisoner in Shackles, Pharsalia's Rhapsody, Requiem, The Shadow Over Petrichor, Underwater Nocturne, The Last Day of Remuria): Canticles of Harmony is a five-part Fontaine World Quest chapter added in version 4.6, after Song of the Dragon and Freedom. The people of the town of Petrichor fall into a dreamlike state, and the Traveler and Paimon follow a strange talking cat, Osse, through the Faded Castle to the drowned Remurian capital to end the corrupted Symphony of the ancient empire of Remuria and send the stolen souls home.

46.content:
Carassius Auratus Chapter (Yoimiya) (also: Carassius Auratus Chapter, Yoimiya's Story Quest, Dreamlike Timelessness, Star-Pickers' Passage): Yoimiya's Story Quest. In Act I the Traveler helps the Naganohara fireworks maker shelter and ship out a fugitive who slipped into Inazuma, and reunites him with a friend who now serves the Tenryou Commission. In Act II Yoimiya leaves Inazuma for the first time and travels to Sumeru, hoping to see a meteor shower.

Plot: Act I: during the Sakoku Decree, Yoimiya hides a wanted man, Sakujirou, and arranges a boat for him while preparing a fireworks show. His old friend Keisuke of the Tenryou Commission is hunting him. Yoimiya stops the conflict with a duel and the two part on better terms. Act II: with the Sakoku Decree gone, Yoimiya travels to Sumeru. The Traveler and Nahida stage a dream meteor shower with the Aranara, which also helps a girl named Avin.

Revelations: Yoimiya shelters a wanted man at risk to herself and her family.

Characters: Yoimiya, the Traveler, Paimon.

47.content: Caribert (also: Chapter III Act VI, Sumeru Archon Quest Act VI): Caribert is the sixth act of Chapter III, the Sumeru Archon Quest (version 3.5). Kaeya, unexpectedly in Sumeru, invites the Traveler and Paimon by letter to Djafar Tavern in Port Ormos, where Dainsleif tells him that his Alberich ancestors founded the Abyss Order. Dainsleif then leads them to a hut in Avidya Forest tied to the sibling's "Loom of Fate" operation, where a man calling himself Eide cares for a sick, masked hilichurl he names Caribert.

key: Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land
Chapter of the Immortal of Song
48.content: Carmen Dei Chapter (also: Carmen Dei, Venti's Story Quest, Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land, Chapter of the Immortal of Song): Carmen Dei Chapter is Venti's Story Quest (Version 1.0), one act titled "Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land". Venti hands the Traveler a "nirnama detector" that reveals imaginary friends, and they follow the trail from Mondstadt's children to Stanley, an old tavern storyteller who tells heroic tales to an aspiring young adventurer. In the end Venti reveals himself as Barbatos to the storyteller and speaks briefly about his own first friend.

49.content: Cataclysm's Quickening (also: Chapter IV Act IV, Fontaine Archon Quest Act IV, Into the Deepwater Murk, The Truth Shrouded in Shadow, Secret Keepers and Forbidden Zones, Calamitous Tread, A Moment's Respite): The fourth act of Fontaine's Archon Quest, set in the Fortress of Meropide where the Traveler and Paimon are serving a short sentence. While Lyney's family quietly searches for the missing Childe, the warden Wriothesley shows them a sluice gate that holds back the Primordial Sea. The gate fails and Neuvillette reseals it, Arlecchino confronts Furina about the Prophecy, and the Traveler realises that Neuvillette is the Hydro Sovereign.

key: Reborn in the Land of Grievances
50.content:
Cerberus Chapter (also: Cerberus, Wriothesley's Story Quest, Reborn in the Land of Grievances, An Opportunity for Rebirth, The Proud "Beret Society", It's What He Deserves): Wriothesley's Story Quest, set in the Fortress of Meropide. A contraband box and a missing hat lead the Traveler, Paimon and the Duke of Meropide to the Beret Society, a supposedly model prisoners' club. Its leader Dougier is secretly controlling members through fear and preparing to overthrow Wriothesley. Wriothesley breaks the Society and later tells the Traveler why he reacted so strongly.

Plot: The Traveler and Paimon return to Meropide and help a Beret Society member find his hat. Wriothesley shows them a contraband box containing a gem that floods holders with bad memories, then takes them to meet Beret Society leader Dougier. Wriothesley secretly investigates, finds that the Society's members are being punished with thorns and a fear solution, raids Dougier's hidden base, and subdues him. Afterwards he explains his past and the Society is dissolved.

Revelations: Dougier controlled Beret Society members with thorn-pin "censure", a fear solution and surveillance, and meant to overthrow Wriothesley.

Characters: Wriothesley, the Traveler and Paimon.

51.content:
Chapter I: Farewell, Archaic Lord (also: Chapter I, Liyue Archon Quest, Farewell, Archaic Lord (chapter)): Chapter I of the Archon Quest, set in Liyue. The Traveler arrives for the Rite of Descension, finds Rex Lapis apparently assassinated, is hunted by the Millelith, and works with the adepti, the Qixing and a suspect ally in the Fatui Harbinger Childe. The Liyue acts end with the revelation that the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor consultant Zhongli is Rex Lapis himself.

Plot: Act I: Rex Lapis falls dead at the Rite of Descension; the Traveler is blamed and seeks the three adepti. Act II: the Traveler and Zhongli gather items for a funeral rite while Childe hunts the Exuvia. Act III: Osial is released and defeated, and Zhongli reveals himself as the Geo Archon. Act IV: the Traveler meets their sibling again.

Revelations: Zhongli is the Geo Archon, Rex Lapis (Morax), and his "death" was staged.

Characters: Traveler and Paimon; Zhongli; Ningguang; Childe; Signora; Xiao; Ganyu; Keqing; Dainsleif; the Traveler's sibling.

52.content:
Chapter II: Omnipresence Over Mortals (also: Chapter II, Inazuma Archon Quest, Inazuma Chapter, Omnipresence Over Mortals chapter): Chapter II of the Archon Quests, titled Omnipresence Over Mortals, takes the Traveler to Inazuma, the closed island nation of the Electro Archon. The Raiden Shogun enforces the Vision Hunt Decree, seizing Visions to protect her ideal of eternity. The Traveler joins the resistance, uncovers Fatui meddling, defeats the Shogun's lieutenants and Signora, and finally reaches the true Archon, Ei. The chapter ends with an Act IV in Liyue's Chasm in which the Traveler and Dainsleif oppose the Abyss Order.

Plot: The Traveler, hoping to find the Electro Archon and learn about their sibling, wins passage to Inazuma in a tournament run by Beidou. In Ritou they meet Thoma and, through him, Kamisato Ayaka, who leads a quiet effort against the Vision Hunt Decree. After a failed attempt to save Thoma from a public ceremony, the Traveler joins the Watatsumi Army's resistance. Yae Miko later helps them expose a Fatui plot, reach the Shogun and defeat her in the Plane of Euthymia, and the Decree is abolished.

key: Chapter III: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana chapter
53.comment: Chapter III: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
53.content:
Chapter III: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana (also: Chapter III, Sumeru Archon Quest, Sumeru Chapter, Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana chapter): Chapter III of the Archon Quests takes the Traveler to Sumeru, the nation of wisdom ruled in name by the Dendro Archon. The Traveler finds that the Sumeru Akademiya's sages have locked the young Archon Nahida away, are harvesting people's dreams through the Akasha network, and are working with the Fatui to build an artificial god. With Nahida's guidance and the help of desert mercenaries and Akademiya dissidents, the Traveler frees her and defeats the false god, who turns out to be the Fatui Harbinger Scaramouche. A separate Act VI follows a memory of the Traveler's sibling.

Plot: Arriving from the Chasm, the Traveler is sent by Tighnari and Collei toward Sumeru City to meet the Archon, and instead is pulled into a city-wide dream loop during the Sabzeruz Festival. The loop's secret leads to Nahida, who has been imprisoned for centuries, and then to the Akademiya's god-making project. Allied with Alhaitham, Cyno, Dehya, Nilou and desert Eremites, the Traveler gets Nahida out and, inside the Akasha, defeats the false god. Nahida purges the forbidden knowledge from Irminsul, and the sages fall.

key: Chapter IV: Masquerade of the Guilty
54.comment: Chapter IV: Masquerade of the Guilty
54.content: Chapter IV: Masquerade of the Guilty (also: Chapter IV, Fontaine Archon Quest, Fontaine Chapter, Masquerade of the Guilty chapter): Chapter IV is the Archon Quest chapter set in Fontaine, the Hydro nation of justice and trials. Acts I to V follow the Traveler and Paimon through courtroom dramas, the Spina di Rosula's hunt for a drug ring and a missing-women case, an undercover stay in the Fortress of Meropide, and finally the fulfilment and defeat of a prophecy that Fontaine's people would dissolve in rising water, leaving the Hydro Archon weeping alone. Act V is titled "Masquerade of the Guilty", the name the travel log gives the whole block. Act VI, "Bedtime Story", is a separate Traveler chapter set in Sumeru.

key: Chapter ??: The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed
The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed
55.comment: Chapter ??: The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed
55.content:
Chapter ??: The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed (also: The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed, Khaenri'ah Archon Quest chapter): "The Dream Yet to Be Dreamed" is the announced title of the Archon Quest chapter centred on the fallen kingdom of Khaenri'ah. As of Version 7.1 it has not been released: there is no playable story, so nothing about its events is canon.

Plot: No plot exists in released canon. Treat any story for this chapter as unknown and do not invent it.

key: Chapter V: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection
56.comment: Chapter V: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection
56.content: Chapter V: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection (also: Chapter V, Natlan Archon Quest, Natlan Chapter, Incandescent Ode of Resurrection chapter): Chapter V is the Archon Quest chapter set in Natlan, the Pyro nation of war. The Traveler and Paimon arrive hoping to find their sibling and meet Mavuika, the human Pyro Archon, and six tribes who have fought the Abyss for centuries. Acts I to V and an Interlude follow the final push to end that war: six chosen heroes with Ancient Names, an invasion of the whole nation, and a last descent into the Night Kingdom. Act VI, "A Space and Time for You", is a separate Traveler chapter about the Abyss Order.

57.content: Chapter VII: Everwinter Without Mercy (also: Chapter VII, Snezhnaya Archon Quest, Snezhnaya Chapter, Everwinter Without Mercy chapter): Chapter VII is the Archon Quest chapter set in Snezhnaya, the Cryo nation of the Tsaritsa and the Fatui. It runs for four acts across Versions 7.0 and 7.1. The Traveler and Paimon cross into the frozen north, find the country strained by an energy-saving policy called Project Stuzha, get tangled in a haunting at the Korolevskiy Theater, and finally meet the Tsaritsa herself. By the end the Traveler has chosen to stand with the Fatui against Ronova, the Ruler of Death.

key: An Ancient Sacrifice of Sacred Brocade
58.content:
Chenyu's Blessings of Sunken Jade (also: Chenyu Vale world quest series, Qiaoying of the Sacred Mountain, Floating Jade, Treasure of Chenyu, An Ancient Sacrifice of Sacred Brocade, Rainjade Rite quest): A Version 4.4 world quest series set in Chenyu Vale, Liyue. The Traveler meets the adeptus Fujin, who says the vale's water and soil are declining, which endangers Qiaoying Village's tea. They gather her scattered power, learn that the beast Lingyuan has been disrupting the land, and see the Rainjade Rite completed.

Plot: Fujin pulls the Traveler into an adepti realm and says Chenyu Vale is declining. In Qiaoying Village tea quality has been dropping. The Traveler seeks a technician, follows a golden carp (Fujin), explores a shrine with Little Mao, gathers Fujin's power from carp across the vale, and faces Lingyuan, who admits she caused the disruption. The Rainjade Rite is then performed.

Characters: The Traveler and Paimon; Fujin (adeptus, golden carp); Lingyuan (a beast called Bluey); villagers Grandpa Lu, Uncle Luo and worker Jin; Fontainian technician Hautemontagne; Little Mao; boatman Bosu.

key: Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses
59.comment: Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses
59.content: Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses (also: Sabzeruz Festival event, Birthday Celebration Anecdotes, Give Her Surprises, Give Her Sweetness, Give Her Memories): Chromatic Ode of Candies and Roses was a limited-time event in Version 5.1 (23 October to 7 November 2024), set in Sumeru during the Sabzeruz Festival, which marks Nahida's birthday. Her friends secretly prepare a birthday surprise built around candy and the Flower Carriage Parade, while Candace's odd visions lead to half of an ancient relic, King Deshret's Wedjat Eye.

key: Chronicler of the Crumbling City World Quest series
60.content: Chronicler of the Crumbling City (also: Chronicler of the Crumbling City World Quest series, Sacred City of Tollan quests): Chronicler of the Crumbling City is a Natlan world quest series in which the Traveler, Paimon and the Little One enter the Great Volcano and discover the buried dragon city of Tollan. A guiding voice speaking through old Secret Source machines helps them restore the city's power, cleanse Abyssal corruption, and obtain the permit needed to reach the Heart of the Sacred Mountain.

61.content:
Cisoria Chapter (Chiori) (also: Cisoria Chapter, Chiori's Story Quest, When They Talk About Tonight): Chiori's Story Quest, set in Fontaine ahead of Fontaine Fashion Week. A rival designer, Uther, tries to ruin Chiori's boutique through a hired attack on her courier, press smears and withdrawn suppliers. With the Traveler and friends from across Fontaine, Chiori exposes his factory and still stages her show.

Plot: Kirara arrives late with Chiori's fabrics from Inazuma, having been attacked by bandits hired to target a courier with two tails. Uther, a rival designer, is behind it. Rumours that Chiori uses underground suppliers cost her customers, models and her accessory maker. She salvages stock into a new collection, then helps expose Uther's unsanitary factory and takes the fashion show.

Characters: Chiori, the Traveler, Paimon and Kirara.

62.content:
Clink Clank Clash (also: Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1): Clink Clank Clash was a limited-time Flagship Event in Version 6.0 (Luna I), played from 2025-09-12 to 2025-09-29, set in Nod-Krai. After the Traveler and Paimon settle in, they find the young inventor Aino and her robot companion Ineffa caught up in a crisis involving stray robots, Guild commissions and a suspicious "outsourced contract". It is a light, comic workshop story told through short event quests and four minigames.

Plot: Aino takes on several commissions at once. A man calling himself Gaudenty says he represents the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau and wants runaway recon bots recovered. The Adventurers' Guild wants a self-defence device made for local adventurers. A Fontainian engineer, Ginette, has lost control of robots she built. In the end Gaudenty is exposed as a fraud who tried to steal Ginette's robots, and a merchant named Asikko takes him away.

63.content: Colors of Emptiness (also: Crimson Cleansing, Blues of the Old World, Colors Out of Space): Colors of Emptiness is a short Nod-Krai World Quest series on Lempo Isle, added in Version 6.0. Two quests, Crimson Cleansing at the north end and Blues of the Old World at the south end of the Nothing Passage, can be done in either order. In each the Traveler and Paimon follow a glowing orb, red in one and blue in the other, that possesses objects and animals as it moves through a gorge once held by the Fatui. When both are done, Colors Out of Space begins: the orbs collide and the Traveler is flung through a strange ruined space. Nothing explains what the orbs are.

64.content:
Crystallina Chapter (also: Crystallina, Skirk's Story Quest, Whispers Betwixt Stars and Night, Sinister Undercurrent, All Devouring, Heart and Mind, Unbounded): The Crystallina Chapter is Skirk's Story Quest, released in Version 5.7. It has one act, Whispers Betwixt Stars and Night. After a nightmare in which something Abyssal stabs the Traveler, Skirk appears in Liyue, says part of the Traveler's soul has been taken, and agrees to help recover it if the Traveler helps her find the thief. The thief proves to be Skofnungr, an old friend of her master Surtalogi.

Plot: The Traveler feels unwell, and Baizhu finds nothing physically wrong. In a dream an Abyssal being stabs them. At Wanmin Restaurant, Skirk sits beside them and says the wound in their soul carries Abyssal corrosion. She trains the Traveler, enters Skirk's memories, then they track the culprit to the Chasm. After a retreat and a crisis inside Skirk's own mind, they return and unmask the culprit as Skofnungr, a Khaenri'ahn follower of Surtalogi, whom Skirk spares by destroying his consciousness.

key: The Truth Is Also a Lie
65.content:
Cypressus Custos Chapter (also: Cypressus Custos, Ayato's Story Quest, The Firmiana Leaf Falls, New Shoots from Old Branches, The Truth Is Also a Lie, The Wind Settles): The Cypressus Custos Chapter is Kamisato Ayato's Story Quest, released in Version 2.6, with one act, The Firmiana Leaf Falls. Rumour says Kujou Kamaji of the Tenryou Commission and Hiiragi Chisato of the Kanjou Commission are to marry. Ayato, head of the Kamisato Clan and Yashiro Commissioner, suspects the match is a trap and, with the Traveler's help, spoils it.

Plot: Two retainers, Ippei and Shinnojou, guess that Kamaji and Chisato will marry. Ayato confirms it but soon suspects a plot. Shinnojou is kidnapped, Matsuura reveals the plotters' hand, and Ayato and Kamaji arrange for public opinion to turn the match against the plotters. Two days later Chisato has the upper hand and Matsuura apologises.

key: The Remains of the Past Day
66.content:
Diluvies Chapter (also: Diluvies, Neuvillette's Story Quest, The Remains of the Past Day, A Familiar Threat, Ever-Surging Memories, In a New Light): Neuvillette's Story Quest, set in the Court of Fontaine. A threatening letter targets the Melusine Kiara, and the Iudex personally investigates because a similar plot once destroyed two people he trusted. Using the Fountain of Lucine, he relives the story of the Melusine Carole and his friend Vautrin. The trail leads to a smuggler in Meropide, and Neuvillette learns that Fontaine now stands with him.

Plot: Neuvillette is investigating a threat to Kiara. The Traveler and Paimon join him, and Clorinde offers to guard Kiara. At the Fountain of Lucine he accidentally pulls the Traveler into a memory of Carole and Vautrin from four hundred years ago. The letter is traced to Esseim, a freed smuggler, and then to Domenico in Meropide. Wriothesley tells Neuvillette he has overthought the case, as people now trust him.

Revelations: Vautrin founded the Mutual Aid Network, whose badge is modelled on the Medal of Peace.

Characters: Neuvillette, the Traveler, Paimon and the Melusine Kiara.

67.content:
Divina Vulpes Chapter (also: Divina Vulpes, Yae Miko's Story Quest, The Great Narukami Offering, Mysterious Urban Legend, Friendship in Writing, A Centuries-Long Dream, Banquet of Parting): The Divina Vulpes Chapter is Yae Miko's Story Quest, released in Version 2.5, with one act, The Great Narukami Offering. A new book, A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits, spreads a wish ritual across Inazuma City and leaves some of its users acting strangely. Miko investigates with the Traveler, finds the cause is an old friend, the Daiyouko youkai Urakusai, and sees him and other spirits off with a final party.

Plot: Rumour in Hanamizaka says a midnight incantation grants any wish. A book explaining it is selling out, and a swordsman who used it is possessed. Miko exorcises the possessing spirit, then tracks down the book's author, a failed novelist, and discovers the spirit behind it is her friend Urakusai. He meant no harm, and Miko promises him a final gathering before he and the other spirits leave.

key: Warriors' Dreams Like Spring Grass Renewing
68.content:
Dracaena Somnolenta Chapter (Sangonomiya Kokomi) (also: Dracaena Somnolenta Chapter, Kokomi's Story Quest, Warriors' Dreams Like Spring Grass Renewing): Kokomi's Story Quest, set on Watatsumi Island just after the Vision Hunt Decree ends. The Traveler joins Kokomi for the Victory Feast and finds a rumour that the Fatui and the Tenryou Commission are plotting to restart the war. The rumour proves to be a plan by grieving Watatsumi soldiers, and Kokomi turns it into a new corps to defend the island.

Plot: On Watatsumi Island the Traveler helps Gorou's soldiers destroy a Fatui ship and learns that rumours of a Tenryou and Fatui plot are circulating before peace talks. Kokomi investigates a Fatui camp, rests secretly in a cave, and holds the Victory Feast. A drunken soldier admits the rumours were fake and meant to restart the war. At the talks with Kujou Sara the soldiers expose the rumour, and Kokomi settles it and forms a new defence corps.

Characters: Kokomi, the Traveler, Paimon and Gorou.

69.content: Draco Rubedo Chapter (also: Draco Rubedo, Durin's Story Quest, The Magic Known as Storytelling): Draco Rubedo Chapter is Durin's Story Quest (Version 6.2, "Luna III"), one act titled "The Magic Known as Storytelling". Alice brings the Traveler and Paimon a book that the Hexenzirkel witches wrote together, which Durin's mother Andersdotter died before finishing. Together they enter the book repeatedly over several days to complete Durin's story and, with Albedo and the Wanderer's help, solve the problem that Durin is mistaken for the evil historical Durin.

70.content:
Dreams, Emptiness, Deception (also: Dreams, Emptiness, and Deception, Chapter III Act III, Sumeru Act III): Dreams, Emptiness, Deception is Act III of the Sumeru Archon Quests. After the Sabzeruz Festival samsara ends, Nahida, speaking through Katheryne, plans with the Traveler to learn what the Akademiya's sages intend. Their plan to turn Setaria, Grand Sage Azar's secretary, is ambushed by the Fatui Harbinger Dottore, who traps Nahida's mind in the Akasha. The Traveler flees toward the desert, where Nahida's last clue sends them to the people of the Great Red Sand and to a meeting at Aaru Village with Alhaitham, Cyno, Dehya and Candace.

Plot: Nahida, borrowing Katheryne, proposes recruiting Setaria. The Traveler possesses Setaria's acquaintances in turn to confront her about her guilt over the desert; she agrees to steal documents but is overheard, and Dottore stages a trap at the Akademiya gate. Nahida holds him off while the Traveler flees. In the forest, Eremite mercenaries attack, and Nahida's mind is caught while sharing the Traveler's body. The Traveler heads to the desert, finds Alhaitham, and at Aaru Village is drawn into a clash between Alhaitham and Cyno.

key: Roll! A Sea of New Acquaintances
71.content:
Duel! The Summoners' Summit! (also: Summoners' Summit, King of Invokations Grand Prix, Commence! A Suspect Genesis, Roll! A Sea of New Acquaintances, Cards Out! Grievances Begone, Culminate! Chatter of Joyous Dreams, Card Snatcher): Duel! The Summoners' Summit! was a limited-time Flagship event in Version 3.7 (25 May to 12 June 2023), built around Genius Invokation TCG. A King of Invokations Grand Prix is being held in every nation. In Mondstadt the Traveler and Paimon meet Charlotte, a reporter for The Steambird, who is chasing a "Card Snatcher" who buys or wins cards bearing a treasure-chest back. They follow the trail to Liyue, Inazuma and Sumeru, where it ends with the Treasure Hoarders, and with a gentler discovery about who created the game.

Plot: In Mondstadt, Diona and Margaret tell the Traveler about the King of Invokations Grand Prix. Charlotte, who researched the Traveler's deeds in detail, recruits them to find the Card Snatcher and brings a bonus payment to Mona, who writes an astrology column for The Steambird. At the finals Timmie beats Kaeya. A suspect Charlotte trails turns out to be Adrian, who sold a plain card back for triple its price to a man who said the Mondstadt ones were done and Liyue was next.

72.content:
Dulciaria Structura Chapter (also: Dulciaria Structura, Escoffier's Story Quest, Treasured Above All, Shaped by Fame, Roasted by Flames, Ice-Frosted Endgame, Gateau Debord quest): Escoffier's Story Quest, set at Hotel Debord in the Court of Fontaine. Navia and the Traveler find the hotel's chefs in trouble: the current head chef, Savanna, drives them hard, and a chef has been injured. They ask Escoffier, the former head chef, for help. A cook-off over the legendary Gateau Debord follows, then a sabotage plot and a trip to a ruin where the cake's secret is buried.

Plot: Escoffier returns for a cook-off against Savanna for the Codex Debord, which holds the founder's recipes. Escoffier loses after someone sabotages her cake. Savanna goes missing the next day and the party follows a map to a ruin where Monica, the real culprit, has her. At the ruin Monica wants the cake's secret ingredient, but it is gone, and Savanna and Escoffier hold a fair cook-off afterwards.

Revelations: Monica sabotaged the cake and plotted against Savanna. The founders' secret ingredient was found in a Remurian ruin.

Characters: Escoffier, Navia, the Traveler and Paimon.

key: East of the Moon, West of the Sun
Proofs of the Cognoscenti quest series
Reed Miller's Great Treasure quest series
73.comment: East of the Moon, West of the Sun
73.content:
East of the Moon, West of the Sun (also: Proofs of the Cognoscenti quest series, Reed Miller's Great Treasure quest series): A Nod-Krai world quest series that begins in Version 6.0. Treasure hunters, many of them from the Snezhnayan city of Novokitezhgrad, are chasing the five Proofs of the Cognoscenti, legendary relics said to point to the Great Treasure of the thief Reed Miller. The Traveler and Paimon collect all five and find the treasure, learning in the process how the hunters' stories connect.

Plot: Four short adventures each yield a Proof of the Cognoscenti: a goblet won from a Fatui officer, a mask at a campfire by Blue Amber Lake, a feather from a ghost-haunted wreck, and a relic found in a doomsday bunker. Tolfin, a storyteller-merchant, leads the Traveler to his grandmother Hiljetta, who owns the fifth and tests the Traveler in a sparring match. The five Proofs open the Great Treasure site.

Characters: The Traveler and Paimon; Tolfin (merchant-storyteller and Treasure Hoarder) and his weasel thief Huginn; Hiljetta, the Black-Barrel Hag; Netochka and Poruchik Raskolnikov; Danyusha and Zhorik Shesternin; Ilmari the fisherman.

74.content: Echoes of a Forsaken Song (also: Forsaken Song quest, Amsvartnir lyre quest, Palaces of Times Bygone): Echoes of a Forsaken Song is a world quest at Amsvartnir, a lake in Wavechaser Plain, Nod-Krai, added in Version 6.3. After the Lunar Conflux Barrier at the lakeshore is melted, a lyre appears; when the Traveler plays it, only the player character hears music and a sorrowful song in an unknown language that the Traveler somehow understands. Seelie lead the Traveler and Paimon up through floating islands to a hidden ruin, the Royal Court of the Seelie, where a mural completes the song and a reward chest holds a handwritten note about a woman who befriended a northern wolf named Boreas.

75.content: Echoing Tales (also: Conch Retrospection, Echoing Conches, Summertime Sparkle event): Echoing Tales was a limited-time event in Version 1.6 (9 June to 21 July 2021, UTC+8) on the Golden Apple Archipelago, the summer island area tied to Midsummer Island Adventure. Players collected Echoing Conches scattered across the islands, each of which replays a spoken fragment of the past. The fragments tell, out of order, of generations of stranded islanders and of shipwrecked Inazuman pirates who try to find a way out through the fog.

key: Song of the Welkin Moon Act II
76.content:
Elegy of Dust and Lamplight (also: Song of the Welkin Moon Act II, Luna I Act II): Act II of Song of the Welkin Moon, set in Nasha Town and around Nod-Krai. A phantom linked to the Wild Hunt is traced to Rerir, one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah. He impersonates the Ratnik Sousi, who is found murdered with Flins blamed, and tries to use the Lightkeepers' kuuvahki cannon to regain strength. The Traveler, Flins and Ineffa blunt the shot, and Columbina pulls the group out of danger.

Plot: The Traveler and Paimon help repair the cannon in Nasha Town and learn of a Wild Hunt phantom. Lauma and Columbina explain the Moon Marrow and identify Rerir. A false "Sousi" proves to be Rerir, the real Sousi is found dead and Flins is blamed. The group deduces that Rerir wants the cannon fired at himself, and it is fired at Starsand Shoal. Columbina teleports everyone out of danger. The act ends with Varka, who has been following Rerir, introducing himself to him.

Revelations: The Wild Hunt's mastermind is Rerir, a Sinner of Khaenri'ah, and he is the origin of the Wild Hunt. The Moon Marrow is described by Columbina as a piece of Aria's remains.

Characters: The Traveler, Paimon, Lauma, Columbina, Flins, Nefer, Aino and Rerir are the main figures.

key: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival
As Though Caught in a Dream
77.comment: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival
77.content: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival (also: Mikawa Festival event, As Though Caught in a Dream, As Though Beholding Illusions, As Though Surrounded by Thunder, As Though Kissed by Dew, Tanuki Game Award, The Doppelganger Incident): Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival was a limited-time Flagship event in Version 5.4 (14 February to 3 March 2025). Yae Miko, with the Shogunate's blessing, stages a new Mikawa Flower Festival for humans and youkai alike and names the Traveler official representative. The festival centres on a 48-hour game-making contest on the theme of dreams. A nightmare then turns up on Mt. Yougou, and the Raiden Shogun has to face the memory of someone she once had to kill.

key: Towers of the Three Realms trials
78.content:
Erebos' Secret (also: Erebos Secret, The Three Great Martial Trials, Towers of the Three Realms trials): A version 2.4 world quest series in Enkanomiya. After the Traveler returns the Bloodbranch Coral to Tsuyuko, a shade named Eboshi, an auxiliary of Sangonomiya and one of the shrine maidens of Enkanomiya, offers a set of trials that lead to more of the island's secrets.

Plot: Eboshi, a translucent shade, meets the Traveler near the Serpent's Heart and proposes a trial path. Agreeing makes three new areas surface from the fog. At each the Traveler is tested, then returns to Eboshi for her explanations.

Characters: The Traveler and Paimon; Eboshi.

79.content:
Everwinter Without Mercy (also: Chapter VII Act I, Snezhnaya Archon Quest Act I): Chapter VII Act I of the Archon Quest and the opening of the Snezhnaya story. The Traveler and Paimon cross into the frozen north, the supposed last stop on the road set by the Traveler's sibling. Paimon falls ill; the pair find a town short of fuel because of Project Stuzha, help an honest hunter expose a hoarding scheme, meet Harbingers Sandrone and Tartaglia, and are recruited into the secret group Rokot.

Plot: The Traveler and Paimon leave for Snezhnaya after a farewell party hosted by Columbina. A gust separates them; the Traveler meets the Eye of Graeae, an ancient device, and finds Paimon asleep in a cabin where a stranger with star-shaped pupils tells them to look after her. In the town of Sretomorozsk the hunter Alyosha explains Project Stuzha and helps unmask a Kresnik Kristall thief. In Snezhnograd the Traveler meets Sandrone, Tartaglia and Odette, then is invited into the Rokot while investigating the project.

Revelations: Snezhnaya is rationing energy under Project Stuzha, ordered by the Tsaritsa to free power for research. Pierro is in Snezhnaya and acts as though he knows Paimon. A covert network, Rokot, gives the disaffected false identities and an outlet, and is at odds with the Fatui.

Characters: The Traveler and Paimon; the hunter Alyosha and his dog Tugarin; the Eye of Graeae; and Snezhnograd's Harbingers and Fatui: Sandrone, Tartaglia, Odette, Pierro.

Consequences: The Traveler is a member of Rokot, has a working train and a Cryo blade, and plans to learn the real purpose of Project Stuzha from Odette. Paimon remains too weak to travel.

Placement: First act of Chapter VII, after the Nod-Krai content and the Song of the Welkin Moon story. Released in version 7.0.

80.content:
Fabulae Textile Chapter (Xingqiu) (also: Fabulae Textile Chapter, Xingqiu's Story Quest, Bookworm Swordsman): The Fabulae Textile Chapter is Xingqiu's Story Quest (Version 1.0), set in Liyue. In its one act, Bookworm Swordsman, the Traveler seeks the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide and ends up helping Xingqiu defend a book collector, Chang the Ninth, from a merchant backed by the Fatui. Xingqiu defeats the merchant by cornering the market in Cor Lapis, and is revealed as heir of the Feiyun Commerce Guild.

Plot: Looking for the Liyue Travel Guide, the Traveler meets Xingqiu, who wants a rare book from Chang the Ninth. Chang is being pressured to sell Cor Lapis cheaply to the merchant Gentry Maocai, who works with a Fatui agent. Xingqiu quietly buys up every scrap of Cor Lapis with Feiyun Commerce Guild money, forces Gentry to deal on his terms, and ensures Chang gets paid and keeps his books.

Characters: Xingqiu, the Traveler and Paimon. Chang the Ninth, Jifang, Changhu, Gentry Maocai, Javert and Xu appear.

81.content: Fabulous Fungus Frenzy (also: Nilotpala Cup, Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament, Beast Tamers Tournament): Fabulous Fungus Frenzy was a limited-time Flagship Event in Version 3.2 (10 to 28 November 2022). In Sumeru the Traveler and Paimon enter the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament, where contestants capture Fungi, boost them with Floral Jelly and command them through Wisdom Orbs. Behind the friendly competition sits a scheme involving the organiser Kautilya and the sponsor Elchingen, and a beast tamer named Haniyyah who wants to destroy all Fungi.

82.content:
Farewell, Archaic Lord (also: Chapter I Act II, Liyue Archon Quest Act II): Chapter I Act II of the Archon Quest, set in Liyue Harbor. With Rex Lapis dead and his body hidden by the Qixing, Childe introduces the Traveler and Paimon to Zhongli, a consultant at the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, who offers to get them to the Geo Archon's vessel if they help him prepare the Rite of Parting.

Plot: At Liuli Pavilion Childe introduces Zhongli, who says he can bring the Traveler to the Exuvia if they help with the Rite of Parting. They buy jade, make perfumes, borrow a bell from Madame Ping, order kites and workers, and get Everlasting Incense from Bubu Pharmacy. The act ends with Ningguang's invitation to the Jade Chamber.

Revelations: The Qixing have hidden the Geo Archon's vessel, the Exuvia; Childe deduces that it is in the Golden House.

Characters: Traveler and Paimon; Zhongli; Childe (Tartaglia); Ekaterina; Ganyu.

83.content:
Felis Fuscus Chapter (also: Felis Fuscus, Lyney's Story Quest, The Forgotten Thief, The Phantom Thief's Reappearance, The Magician's Secret, The Truest Thing, The Interview, Phantom Weasel): Lyney's Story Quest, set in the Court of Fontaine. Ten years after a thief called the Phantom Weasel vanished, a poster announces the return. The Great Magician Lyney recruits the Traveler and Paimon as temporary assistants to find the culprit. They clear the name of Cesar, a dead stage magician wrongly branded the thief, expose his killer, and then learn the thief was someone else.

Plot: Charlotte reports that the Phantom Weasel, a thief never caught ten years ago, is back. Lyney offers to investigate and has the Traveler and Paimon help look into Cesar's death. They find Cesar's former apprentice Lorenzo is hiding something, are attacked, and find Cesar's diary and workshop. Lorenzo admits he killed Cesar and was the Phantom Weasel. The next day Lyney performs Cesar's old trick at the Opera Epiclese and reveals Jemma was behind it. Jemma later turns herself in.

Revelations: Cesar was killed by his apprentice Lorenzo, and Cesar was not the Phantom Weasel. The thief was Jemma, who manipulated Lorenzo.

Characters: Lyney, Lynette, the Traveler and Paimon.

84.content: Film Notes (also: Film Notes World Quest series, "Outlander Brigade!", Mushounin, Xavier's second film): Film Notes is a two-quest Inazuma world series (2.8). The Fontainian filmmaker Xavier is making another film with help from the Yashiro Commission, but his supporting actors Sasano and the Kamisato servant Koharu quit over his confusing script, adapted from a novel by the unsuccessful writer Kayabuki Ikkei. After a story told by Okazaki Rikuto, Xavier rewrites it as "Mushounin", based on a legend of Seishimaru, and the film is shot with the Traveler in the lead.

key: The Blazing Stars Ring in Fortune
The Stars Inscribe the Year's Wishes
85.content: Fleeting Colors in Flight (also: Lantern Rite 2022, Version 2.4 Lantern Rite event, The Blazing Stars Ring in Fortune, Sky-Gazers, Land-Walkers, The Stars Inscribe the Year's Wishes, Flameplume Starflowers, Oceanic Defender event): Fleeting Colors in Flight was the Version 2.4 Lantern Rite flagship event (25 January to 12 February 2022). Liyue's Qixing prepare a first fireworks show for the festival, with Keqing in charge and badly overworked. The Traveler and Paimon accompany her as she brings festive gifts to the adepti, help catch Treasure Hoarders who have been stealing the fireworks, and finally tell her a story about resting before the show begins.

key: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
86.comment: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
86.content: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn (also: Chapter V Act I, Natlan Act I, Natlan! A New Adventure): Act I of Chapter V is the Traveler's arrival in Natlan. The Traveler and Paimon meet Kachina of the Children of Echoes, follow her to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, and meet Mualani and Kinich. They watch the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame, a tournament that decides who fights the Abyss, and then visit Mualani's village, where the Traveler purges fresh Abyssal corruption from Mualani's gravely wounded friend Atea but cannot undo the old damage; she has only days to live.

key: Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles World Quest series
Fontaine Research Institute, Stagnating in the Rubble
87.content: Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles (also: Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles World Quest series, Fontaine Research Institute, Stagnating in the Rubble, Institute Survey Anchor quests): Fontaine Research Institute Chronicles is a world quest series added in version 4.1. After the explosion that wrecked most of the Fontaine Research Institute, the surviving staff recruit outside adventurers. The Traveler and Paimon go through a slow qualification review, then escort a senior researcher named Nacker into the floating ruins of the Central Laboratory. A reporter from The Steambird, Chronie, follows them.

88.content:
For a Tomorrow Without Tears (also: Prologue Act II, Mondstadt Archon Quest Act II): For a Tomorrow Without Tears is Act II of the Mondstadt Prologue, the first Archon Quest chapter. After the Four Winds temples are cleared, the Traveler returns to Mondstadt, is made an Honorary Knight of Favonius and joins the bard Venti in a plan to cure the dragon Stormterror, who is really Dvalin, of the corruption the Abyss Order is exploiting. The plan needs the Holy Lyre der Himmel, which must be obtained, recovered from the Fatui and repaired with Dvalin's tears. At Starsnatch Cliff an Abyss Mage turns Dvalin against them and the lyre is broken.

Plot: Returning to report to Jean, the Traveler finds her outside the Goth Grand Hotel dismissing a masked Fatui diplomat who urges that the dragon simply be dealt with by the Fatui. The Traveler becomes an Honorary Knight. Paimon then tracks a boy in the streets who sings about Stormterror: Venti. He tells them to meet at the great tree in Windrise, explains that Dvalin is degrading and that the Abyss Order is exploiting it, and says the Holy Lyre der Himmel at the Favonius Cathedral can help. The attempt to borrow it fails, a Fatui mage takes it first, and Diluc and Jean help recover it. After restoring it with Dvalin's tears the party summons him at Starsnatch Cliff, where an Abyss Mage ruins everything.

key: From Dusk to Dawn in Byakuyakoku
89.comment: From Dusk to Dawn in Byakuyakoku
89.content: From Dusk to Dawn in Byakuyakoku (also: Byakuyakoku world quest series, Enkanomiya world quest series): From Dusk to Dawn in Byakuyakoku is the World Quest series, added in version 2.4, that introduces Enkanomiya, a hidden realm beneath Inazuma whose old name is Byakuyakoku. The Traveler and Paimon come to recover the Bloodbranch Coral, pass through a gate with the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, and are drawn into a trial in the ruined kingdom. A helper named Enjou guides them, then proves to be an Abyss Order agent.

key: From One Case to Another World Quest series
90.content: From One Case to Another (also: From One Case to Another World Quest series, Pakpaka Flying School mystery, Saurus Cracker case): From One Case to Another is a four-part Natlan world quest series added in version 5.2. At Pakpaka Flying School in the Scorchwind Trial Grounds, a young student named Taruka suspects the cheerful instructor Lamizana of plotting something dangerous around an upcoming air race.
